race.comment: VEXATIOUS CHOICE (10) has mixed his form this prep but was much better last time when just missing KALOSYNI at Murray Bridge. Meets her with a good pull at the weights and is at peak fitness. Can go one better. ZENACITY (11) has been finding the line nicely without winning and should get a tempo to suit. Holder sticking is a good push. KALOSYNI (6) kept finding to hold them off and return a winner at Murray Bridge. Drawn less kindly this time and does concede weight to a few of these. Will have to improve. ROCKTAGON (1) has worked himself into better form and finds a nice race to keep the ball rolling. Has proven versatile with his speed, so will be interesting to see what they do from out there. ILLUSTRATES (5) skipped through the conditions to score fresh at Balaklava. Should improve second-up and keeps the 3kg claimer on. In the mix.
